Visitor replaces video with custom link

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorVideoCustom struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorVideoCustom) VisitVideo(ctx htmd.NodeContext, src *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`[VIDEO: %s]`, *src))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorVideoCustom{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Watch our tutorial:</p><video src="tutorial.mp4" width="320" height="240" controls></video><p>Great content!</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
